responsibility: Defines the 32-bit x86 GNU-userspace ELF target configuration. It provides assembler syntax and register mappings, 32-bit ABI type sizes, linker and assembler specs, BSS/common output helpers, DWARF EH data-relative encoding support, and glibc-specific thread offsets for stack protector and split stack, making it the main 32-bit GNU ELF OS/ABI adaptation header for the i386 backend.
